group: getValidationContext() - child schema inherits parent context

cases.expected: the same ValidationContext instance as the parent schema (reference equality)
cases.description: Build a parent JsonSchema using the `from` factory with a known ValidationContext. Then create a child schema by calling parent.getSubSchema(JsonNodePath.of("#/properties/child")) (or invoke the private constructor that accepts a parent). Verify that child.getValidationContext() returns the identical ValidationContext object that was given to the parent.

cases.expected: the original ValidationContext instance (reference equality) – configuration does not replace it
cases.description: Instantiate a JsonSchema (via `from`) with a known ValidationContext. Call schema.withConfig(new SchemaValidatorsConfig()) which returns a new JsonSchema instance. Ensure that the new instance’s getValidationContext() still returns the original ValidationContext object, confirming that configuration changes do not create a new ValidationContext.
